data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 先把这一拍敲稳
data.description: 虹夏没有开整套架子鼓，只把练习垫搬到窗边。她握着鼓棒重复一小节，听见节拍器响起才轻轻点头。
data.promptProse: Nijika sits on a drum stool by the rehearsal-room window in an indigo sleeveless top and olive cargo trousers. She holds two sticks above a small practice pad, following the metronome beside it. Daylight gives a clear view of her wrists and the pad surface.
data.animaCaption: Each hand holds one stick, both positioned above the practice pad.
data.action: 跟着节拍器在练习垫上练一小节
